snippet.title: Dig, Dig & Craft! | Shuttle Mining Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595480/Shuttle_Mining/

Explore, mine, and upgrade! Shuttle Mining is a Mining game where every rock you blast and every resource you collect can help you craft own unique powerful lazers!

🌌 Features:

Procedurally generated, fully destructible caves

Skill-based zero-gravity movement and drilling

Powerful upgrades and modifiable lazers

Alien secrets waiting below

Are you ready to dive into the unknown?

🔔 Subscribe for updates and follow the development on https://discord.gg/b42RaP9s
